attention.focus: Possible HF radio impacts during elevated space weather
attention.whyItMatters: Geomagnetic activity can change HF propagation — useful for amateur radio literacy and receiver expectations.
attention.whatChanged: Sample narrative: conditions may be more disturbed than a quiet-week baseline.
attention.calmGuidance: If you operate HF, expect variable paths; keep notes. No need for emergency framing from this sample alone.

summary: Elevated space weather may affect HF radio conditions for careful listeners.
explanation: Space weather couples the Sun–Earth environment to ionospheric behavior. For Signal Intelligence, the educational goal is to notice when radio openings or closures might relate to geomagnetic conditions — and to cross-link Outdoor Intelligence later — without inventing outages or panic.
